body.x: XactTrax GPS Tracking Solutions Offers an Easy Way to Protect, Track and Locate Loved Ones, Pets and Valuable Assets

NEW YORK, Jan. 5 /PRNewswire/ -- Xact Technology, LLC, a DMC Worldwide company and leading provider of consumer electronics products, announces the launch of XactTrax – a GPS personal tracking device designed to monitor and track the location of loved ones, pets, property and assets, anytime, anywhere in the world. With no monthly subscription required, XactTrax offers a user friendly and extremely flexible web based portal and enhanced security features which provides the ideal solution in protecting, locating and tracking small children, teenagers, elderly friends and family, pets, vehicles, ATV's, boats, jet skis, valuable assets and so much more.

"For many years the government and major corporations have utilized GPS technology to keep track of people, objects and vehicles. Personal, everyday use of these advance devices has not been feasible or affordable – until now," said William Acevedo, VP of Business Development, Xact Technology. "With XactTrax, we bring the most cost effective and reliable tracking solutions to the palm of your hand. Parents can ensure their child safely arrives home after school or that their teenager doesn't go over the speed limit. You can be notified when your beloved pet strays from the yard, relax knowing your elderly relative has access to an emergency panic alarm, or be instantly alerted when your bike or motorcycle is tampered with. Now that's peace of mind."

Utilizing a proprietary easy-to-use web-based portal, XactTrax provides a user-friendly dashboard for easy management of features and preferences such as motion detection, panic alarms, travel logging, speed notification, emergency contact list management and alerts, and the ability to set invisible geo-fences around individuals or objects. In addition, XactTrax has partnered with National Alert Registry to offer the National Offender Database to users, which offers notifications and alerts direct to Xact tracking devices and the web portal contacts to enhance the safety features available for the protection of children.

Locating a person or object has never been easier. Location requests are initiated either on the web portal or can be sent and received via txt message from any mobile phone. The results are displayed on a convenient and easy to read map, providing the physical address, date and time data and a robust suite of additional features. From people to pets to recreational vehicles, let XactTrax be your personal watchdog. XactTrax will be available for sale starting April 1, 2010.
Look for XactTrax at CES 2010 in Booth #9817.

Xact Technology, LLC (Xact), is a full-service provider of groundbreaking consumer electronics products.
